_comment: Citation for the 10e core ±1 modifier cap on Hit and Wound rolls. Faction-neutral; affects every unit in every game.

simulator.modifier_cap_plus_minus_one.rule_name: Hit Roll / Wound Roll modifier cap
simulator.modifier_cap_plus_minus_one.quoted_text: Hit roll modifiers are cumulative, but the Hit roll for an attack can never be modified by more than -1 or +1. Wound roll modifiers are cumulative, but the Wound roll for an attack can never be modified by more than -1 or +1.
simulator.modifier_cap_plus_minus_one.trigger: any attack resolution where two or more sources contribute Hit-roll or Wound-roll modifiers (e.g. detachment +1 to wound + stratagem +1 to wound, or Heavy + Devastator Doctrine + cover stacking)
simulator.modifier_cap_plus_minus_one.effect: the net Hit-roll modifier and the net Wound-roll modifier are each independently clamped to the range [-1, +1] before the d6 target is computed. Re-roll effects (Oath of Moment, twin-linked, judgement tokens) are NOT modifiers and are unaffected. Save rolls have a separate cap that is not implemented here.
